# x402 Email Canonicalizer

Normalize email addresses for reliable deduplication and matching.

- POST /api/canonicalize  { email, options? }
- Free discovery: GET /catalog
- Price: ~0.003–0.007 USDC per call
- Pure deterministic rules (lowercase, Gmail-style +tag and dot removal, domain cleanup)

Agent use cases: identity resolution, user matching, spam filtering, CRM dedup, account linking.
